Name: Millo
Description: The great terrace or fill in Jerusalem that David built up when he took the city, that Solomon raised levies to repair, and that Hezekiah strengthened when Sennacherib came; the stepped stone structure in the City of David is proposed as its remains.
BiblicalSignificance: Millo was Jerusalem's engineering: the fill that made the steep city buildable, repaired by every king who took the city's defence seriously.
KeyScriptures: 2 Samuel 5:9; 1 Kings 9:15; 1 Kings 9:24; 1 Kings 11:27; 1 Chronicles 11:8; 2 Chronicles 32:5
RelatedPeople: King David; King Solomon; King Hezekiah
RelatedEvents: David Becomes King; Building of Solomon's Temple; Hezekiah and Sennacherib's Invasion
